item.title: DHS Secretary Noem stands by body camera requirement for federal agents
item.description: DHS Secretary Kristi Noem defends body camera decision for federal agents after Trump says "it wasn't my decision." Move aims to ensure truth in conflicts.

item.title: Trump falsely accuses Black cities of 'horrible corruption' in elections
item.description: Donald Trump exclusively calling out cities that have a majority Black and Brown population is not a coincidence to critics of the president.

item.title: Trump White House press secretary slams Bad Bunny after Grammys dig
item.description: Karoline Leavitt accused Bad Bunny and other celebrities of a double standard after several Grammy winners slammed the Trump administration.

item.title: Swalwell in the hot seat after spending over $200K in campaign cash on personal
item.description: A campaign finance expert is slamming Rep. Eric Swalwell, D-Calif., for spending over $200,000 of his congressional campaign cash on an "inherently personal" expense: childcare.

item.title: California business group unveils Times Square billboard comparing Newsom to NY
item.description: A business group launched a Times Square billboard comparing California Gov. Gavin Newsom to the struggling New York Jets amid 2028 presidential speculation.
